# Capability Boundary Model

Assess boundaries across:

- user intent and trigger language;
- expected outcome and completion criteria;
- workflow, state, and recovery;
- tools, permissions, and external effects;
- knowledge, prompts, scripts, assets, and mutable data;
- context loading and host portability;
- evaluation and quality thresholds;
- owner, version, release cadence, consumers, and blast radius.

Strong separation signals are different users, permissions, side effects, lifecycle, or tests. Strong cohesion signals are one intent, shared invariants, shared state, and a unified completion contract.
